body.purpose: All prose: bio, descriptions, achievement text.

label.purpose: Dates, location, time, and compact metadata (JetBrains Mono).

reading.purpose: Quantified before-to-after measurements (JetBrains Mono, one step larger than Label).

motion.name: section-fade
motion.value: opacity + 12px directional slide, 0.35s ease-out, once per viewport entry
motion.purpose: Restrained entrance for sections and log rows — no bounce, no overshoot.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.purpose: Light/dark toggle crossfade; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Plain editorial heading followed by a flexible hairline; creates continuity without numbering.
components.css: .ds-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 40px; } .ds-section-heading h2 { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #18181B; margin: 0; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-section-heading span { display: block; height: 1px; flex: 1; background: #E4E4E7; }

components.name: Reading Line
components.description: Plain-text before-to-after measurement; the arrow carries Signal Blue, everything else stays Ink.
components.css: .ds-reading { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #18181B; } .ds-reading-arrow { color: #2563EB; margin: 0 6px; } .ds-reading-context { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: #71717A; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Rounded-full pill — the system's one rounding exception, used for skills/tech tags only.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; color: #71717A; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Log Row
components.description: Two-column label + content row separated by a single hairline rule; no card, no shadow.

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr; gap: 24px; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E4E4E7; } .ds-row-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #71717A; } .ds-row-content h3 { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #18181B; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-row-content p { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #71717A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Name-led sticky navigation; active links use an underline and mobile opens a text-led section index.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #71717A; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: #18181B; } .ds-nav-link--active { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #2563EB; text-underline-offset: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a personal editorial index: one continuous record of Wahyu as a person, the roles he is growing into, and the work that proves his range. Authentic photographs create the opening human impression. Experience and selected work then provide the evidence, followed by capabilities and education as supporting context.

The design stays calm and almost monochrome. Scale, composition, changing section density, and generous whitespace create emphasis instead of decorative effects. The dynamic role line intentionally represents real breadth across AI, data, analytics, software engineering, and business intelligence.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial section headings connect to flexible hairline rules without numbering
Real quantified outcomes are set as plain-text "before → after" readings, never as a decorative stat widget
One accent (Signal Blue) used only for labels, links, and active states — never a background fill
Inter for all prose and headings; JetBrains Mono for every number, date, coordinate, and reading
Flat by design: hairline rules and whitespace do the separating work that cards and shadows do elsewhere
Plain white ground — no background texture
One featured project creates the primary work-focused peak in the page

rules.name: The One-Mark Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue identifies the current action or a meaningful measurement. It is never a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only-Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is a real measurement, date, or coordinate — never as a "technical" costume on ordinary prose.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system casts a shadow. If a boundary is needed, it is a 1px hairline rule; if separation is needed, it is whitespace.

dos: Do let authentic photography establish personality before work evidence takes over.
Do preserve the dynamic role line because it represents real professional breadth.
Do use changing scale and whitespace to create rhythm between sections.
Do keep JetBrains Mono reserved for genuine measurements, dates, and coordinates.
Do separate every section and entry with a hairline rule and whitespace, never a card or shadow.
Do render a real quantified outcome as a plain before → after reading; omit it entirely where no real number exists.
Do keep the page background plain white — no grid, no texture.
donts: Don't reintroduce station numbers or numbered section labels.
Don't copy the composition of a reference portfolio; borrow only principles such as pacing, hierarchy, and authentic imagery.
Don't add card-heavy scaffolding, shadows, gradients, or glass effects.
Don't invent a stat bar, progress ring, or sparkline to represent a number — set the real number as text or don't show one.
Don't introduce a second accent color; the system has exactly one.
Don't round anything beyond the one pill-chip exception — no rounded cards, no circular badges.
